_provenanceNote: SCAFFOLD ONLY -- every content field is null, deliberately. Maclean 1894 is NOT held in this repository (confirmed by a filename search across the whole tree during the session that created this file). What the repo does hold is every one of the 439 components in components/east-syriac.json carrying an exact Maclean page citation in meta.source, and 324 of them carrying a meta.note with substantial cited detail, including verbatim quotation from Maclean's own Introduction. That is enough to write this file from -- but it must be written from the source pages read directly, in the manner the Anglican file was, not assembled out of internal audit notes written for a different purpose. Maclean's Introduction, pp.xiii-xxii, is the natural basis for the depth-3 tradition explanation: it is the source's own structural account of the East Syriac office, and it is already quoted in several places in this repository. Josh supplies Maclean page ranges by upload; direct fetch from the ACOE California mirror hard-truncates at ~p.45 regardless of approach and must not be retried.
